title: Label
description: One human judgment about whether a Technical Credit is present at one place in a repo. DRAFT: needs team sign-off. Fields shared with candidates point at candidate.schema.json, so their names, types and allowed values can never drift apart. This file matches src/tc_detector/contracts/label.py. The Python code also checks what JSON Schema can't: that label_id was built from the other fields, and that one repo's label file has one repo, one commit and no duplicate ids. See ground_truth/LABEL_FORMAT.md.

labeller.description: One of the four team members, by their letter in the plan.

optional_labeller.description: A team member's letter, or null when nobody fills this role.

label_id.description: PROPOSAL. Unique name for this label, built exactly like a candidate id (repo:service:file:location:pattern), so evaluation can say which label matched which candidate.

repo.description: Which target repo. Must be the 'name' of that repo in targets.yaml (needs team sign-off).

is_tc.description: The final verdict that evaluation scores: true = this credit is present, false = judged absent. After a disagreement this is the settled answer.

second_labeller.description: Who labelled it a second time, for the 20% agreement sample; null if not in the sample. Never the same person as labeller.

second_is_tc.description: PROPOSAL. The second labeller's own verdict, needed for Cohen's kappa. Set exactly when second_labeller is set.

adjudicated_by.description: PROPOSAL. Who settled a disagreement between the two labellers (either of them, or anyone else). Null when there was no disagreement.

notes.description: Free-text reason for the verdict; may be empty.

allOf.description: Copied from candidate.schema.json (a $ref can't reuse another schema's allOf): a line_range label needs a file and both line numbers; any other unit must have null line numbers.
Copied from candidate.schema.json: a file label must say which file.
second_labeller and second_is_tc are both null, or both set.
Only a label with two labellers can have a disagreement to settle.
This block and the next: with two labellers and no adjudicator, they agreed, so second_is_tc must equal is_tc.
This block and the three after it (one per team member): nobody can be their own second labeller.
